name: (PART 1.5) Sword Champions Simulator
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to  Sword Champions Simulator! ⚔️
Train your strength and become the ultimate warrior! Swing your sword to gain Power, unlock stronger swords, and take on fearsome mobs to prove your might.

💥 Features:

🗡️ Swing to gain Power and upgrade to epic new swords

👹 Battle mobs for rewards and glory

👑 Capture the King of the Hill to show your dominance

🔁 Rebirth to gain multipliers and rise faster

⚔️ Challenge other players in intense duels

Can you climb to the top and become the strongest fighter in the world?

Inspired by sword simulator remastered
